//: The two shipping projects, named one by one rather than globbed as ../src/**/*.csproj. A
glob would silently pick up a third project the day one is added, and whether it belongs in
the published reference is a decision somebody should make in a diff. DocsSiteTests pins
this list to the projects under src/, so the decision cannot be skipped by omission in
samples/ is deliberately absent. The console tour and the live sweep are executables that
demonstrate the library; their internals are not a surface anybody calls.
TargetFramework is pinned because DocFX loads these through MSBuildWorkspace and a
multi-targeted project would otherwise be ambiguous. There is only net10.0 today; the
property is what keeps this file honest if that ever stops being true.
Content is enumerated rather than globbed as **/*.md, so that a working document written into
docs/ later is not published by accident. guides/ is listed; anything else has to be added
README.md is the repository README, rendered from the same file: one copy of the reference, on
GitHub and here. It is where the measured IBKR behaviour lives -- the surprises section is the
most valuable page in this repository -- and the guides link into it by anchor rather than
restating it. DocFX accepts the relative parent path and rejects an absolute one.
//sitemap: The one place in this repository that spells out the public URL. DocFX emits relative links
everywhere else, which is why the site works unchanged under a /ibkrdotnet/ path -- but a
sitemap has to carry absolute ones, so a wrong value here is the single thing that would point
search engines at a host that does not serve this site.
